programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Sementara beberapa anggota keluarga memperlakukannya dengan baik, yang lain terus-menerus menghina dan meremehkannya.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: A smart journalist Reet and hot-headed Raghav enter an arranged marriage through the 'Aata Sata' custom to secure their siblings' happiness. Their relationship of convenience faces unexpected turns.

programme.title: Kemilau Cinta Di Langit Jingga
programme.desc: Rhoma Irama and his girlfriend Aida (Yati Octavia) are hired to make a film by Leo (Harun Syarief) and his henchman Richard (Hendra Cipta), while at the same time Rhoma himself is also holding several performances in the same city. Leo is part of a criminal syndicate. For him, the film is a cover for his criminal activities. Richard, who is still in love with Aida, tries to separate Rhoma from Aida

programme.title: Indigo
programme.desc: Zora has been described as an indigo since young, making her life always haunted and targeted by supernatural beings. Alongside her younger sister, who is also an indigo, they strive to overcome their fear of these unseen attacks.

programme.title: Ajian Nyi Mas Gandasari
programme.desc: The story of the beautiful legend of Nyi Mas Gandasari, who studied under Sunan Gunung Jati. She required any man who wished to marry her to defeat her in a test of knowledge.

programme.title: Haunted Universities
programme.desc: A horror anthology featuring stories of students dealing with paranormal entities. From students being pursued by the ghost of a suicide victim to a party-goer determined to fulfill one last request for her friend.

programme.title: Kedarnath
programme.desc: A Hindu-Muslim love story, Kedarnath portrays how a Muslim pithoo saves a Hindu tourist from the Uttrakhand floods at the pilgrimage, and the love that eventually develops between them.

programme.title: Ra One
programme.desc: In London, Jenny Nayar, an employee of UK-based company Barron Industries, introduces a new technology that allows things from the digital world to enter the real world using wireless transmissions from multiple devices. Shekhar Subramaniam, who also works for the company, is given a final chance to devise a unique video game. To impress his skeptical son Prateek and upon the request of his wife Sonia, Shekhar uses his son's idea that the antagonist should be more powerful than the protagonist. Shekhar's colleague Akashi does the motion capture of the game's characters, Jenny does the programming, and Shekhar gives his face to the game's protagonist, G. One, while the antagonist, Ra. One, is faceless and has substantially greater powers than those granted to G. One, including shapeshifting and mind reading, and is imbibed with a self-learning AI.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Action adventure in which the formula for a cancer-curing medicine is stolen, and a kung-fu fighting team must overcome rivals and doublecrosses in order to get it back

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: A master monk tries to protect a naive young physician from a thousand-year-old snake demon. A contest of psychic powers results in mayhem.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master, he fights to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Best friends Bodil and Isabel, apparently happily married, sneak off for secret affairs using each other as an alibi. But when Isabel is killed when they were supposed to have been together. Bodil gets caught up in her own web of lies.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: A poor couple, Shui and Ti, try to make a life on their own. And through both of their hard work, Shui becomes a marketing executive, then his attitude begins to change.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Ming is a mole in the police department and Yan is a police mole in the Triads. Leading parallel lives, Ming and Yan are feeling increasingly trapped in their false surroundings and they're desperate to find a way out.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Fate Of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino is a mediocre con artist who crosses paths with Kwan, a fellow con artist. Together, they impersonate various people and create numerous schemes to make money. Meanwhile, gangsters are making a scheme of their own.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter who decides to life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. He is implicated in the fights and conspiracies. When his friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must save his friend.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

Tidak Hanya Sekadar Bermain, Main Bareng Blox Juga Menyuguhkan Pengalaman Unik Dari Para Gamers Yang Ikut Serta, Mulai Dari Review Game, Tips Seru, Hingga Momen-Momen Kejutan Yang Terjadi Saat Bermain.

programme.title: Terkepo-Kepo
programme.desc: Program Informasi Dokumenter, Menyajikan Berbagai Informasi Yang Dekat Dengan Kehidupan Sehari-Hari Dan Dibahas Dari Berbagai Sudut Pandang Disertai Dengan Pemaparannya. Selain Menghibur, Program Ini Juga Kaya Akan Pengetahuan Sehingga Akan Menambah Banyak Wawasan Bagi Pemirsa.

programme.title: Lensa Indonesia Malam
programme.desc: Program Berita Yang Menghadirkan Informasi Terkini, Rangkuman Peristiwa Yang Terjadi Dari Malam Hingga Dini Hari Dengan Dua Segmen Khusus, Yaitu Lensa Dunia Dan Lensa Arena Yang Membahas Berbagai Informasi Olahraga Di Indonesia Maupun Mancanegara

programme.title: Ijin, Ndan !
programme.desc: Ijin, Ndan Adalah Program Crimetainment Yang Menggabungkan Informasi Seputar Kejahatan Dan Kriminalitas Dengan Sketsa Komedi Situasional Yang Berlatar Di Ruang Interogasi Atau Kantor Polisi. Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. Dengan Gaya Penyajian Yang Ringan, Menghibur, Dan Penuh Humor, Ijin, Ndan Tetap Konsisten Menyampaikan Fakta Aktual Dan Pesan Edukatif Kepada Penonton, Menjadikannya Tontonan Yang Informatif Sekaligus Mengundang Tawa.

programme.title: Abrakadabra
programme.desc: Abrakadabra Merupakan Sebuah Reality Show Yang Menghadirkan Hiburan Street Magician, Dimana Para Pesulap Akan Memberikan Keajaiban Dengan Trik-Trik Rahasia Yang Memukau Setiap Mata Di Sekitar Area Publik Untuk Mendapatkan Reaksi Kagum, Tak Percaya Dan Kaget Dari Penonton Maupun Semua Orang Yang Melihatnya Secara Langsung Di Lokasi.

programme.title: Kokom (Kompilasi Komedi)

programme.desc: Siraman Rohani Kristen Yang Berkaitan Dengan Kehidupan Untuk Mendekatkan Diri Kepada Tuhan Yesus Kristus. Program Ini Akan Dibagi Menjadi Beberapa Bagian, Antara Lain Kesaksian, Renungan, Serta Konseling Yang Akan Dipandu Oleh Dua Orang Host

programme.title: Movinesia

programme.title: Ustadz On The Road

programme.title: Lil Wild
programme.desc: Sekumpulan Sahabat Yaitu Rara Si Gajah Yang Penuh Aksi, Wobi Buaya Jenius, Meep Harimau Putih Pemalu, Kokeko Si Berang-Berang Yang Banyak Akal, Dan Dil Seekor Merpati Yang Pemberani. Mereka Tinggal Di Suatu Kebun Binatang Yang Sudah Mereka Anggap Seperti Rumah Mereka Sendiri. Mereka Berpetualang Dan Bergembira Bersama Untuk Menyelamatkan Kebun Binatang.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: Kisah Lucu Dan Jenaka Tentang Kehidupan Quynh Dan Orang-Orang Disekitarnya. Sebagai Anak Yang Nakal Tetapi Cerdas Dan Banyak Akal, Quynh Dan Teman-Temannya Akan Membawa Pengalaman Hidup Yang Penuh Warna Di Pedesaan Vietnam Pada Abad Ke-18. Menyoroti Juga Tentang Nilai-Nilai Budaya Rakyat Dan Hubungan Dengan Keluarga, Teman, Guru, Siswa, Dan Lingkungan. Trang Quynh Akan Membawa Tawa Bagi Penonton Dan Mengajarkan Mereka Tentang Keintiman, Persahabatan, Dan Nilai-Nilai Kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.
